FAQ
Frequently asked questions
Quick answers to questions you may have about pricing
Can I change my plan after the trial ends?
Yes, you will be able to subscribe to a plan of your choice by adding your payment method on the Billing & Usage page.
Can I change my plan or cancel my subscription at any time?
Yes, you can upgrade or downgrade your plan at any time during the course of your subscription. You can also cancel your subscription by reaching out to us at
support@hackerearth.com
How will I be billed if I change my plan?
When you upgrade your plan, the change will take effect immediately, and you’ll be charged on a pro-rata basis. If you choose to downgrade or cancel, the change will be applied from your next billing cycle.
Will I be charged for a test invite that a candidate did not accept?
While you can send unlimited test invites, you will only be charged for attempted tests
Will I be charged automatically when my free trial ends?
Yes. If you have selected a paid plan and added a payment method, your subscription will automatically renew as a paid plan when the free trial ends. You can cancel or change your plan before the trial expires to avoid being charged.
